therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation and survival signaling
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: PFS Hazard Ratio and Objective Response Rate in Part 2

results.effect_size: HR 0.365, 95% CI 0.164-0.808 for PFS; 0% ORR in Part 2
biomarker_changes: KRAS mutation status changed from wild-type at baseline to mutant at time of second biopsy
subgroup_findings: Wild-type vs mutant KRAS showed significant PFS difference
results.dose_information: Panitumumab 6 mg/kg IV over 60 minutes; Irinotecan 180 mg/m² IV; AMG 479 12 mg/kg IV over 60 minutes

context.comparator: None - single arm study with resistance mechanism evaluation
